newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable short interest stock rises.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable short interest stock rises.

text.p: Optical Cable Corp said Friday that short interest in "OCCF" stock had increased to 755,318 shares from 725,889 last month.
The company said short interest accounted for 28.5 percent of its 2.7 million outstanding shares.

"When people sell the shares short, they are gambling that long-term shareholders will sooner or later be willing to sell shares at a lower price to them," it said. "They are generally in as short-term players and can only win if we let them.
"We shall do everything in our power to set up a battle front against this type of activity."
Optical Cable, which specializes in fiberoptic cable, said it would not issue any additional shares in the present circumstances.
In August it asked securities authorities to investigate the short interest position.
